seasons.theme: First D2R ladder season, launched two weeks after Patch 2.4 brought class balance changes, new runewords and mercenary reworks.
seasons.notes: Start: April 28, 2022, 5 PM PDT (Americas); April 29, 2 AM CEST / 9 AM KST. Patch 2.4 went live April 14, 2022. End not published by Blizzard. Secondary sources conflict: Blizzard Watch and vhpg.com say Season 1 ended October 6, 2022, when Season 2 began; aoeah.com says October 3, 2022.

seasons.theme: Introduced ladder-only Sunder Charms; Patch 2.5 had added Terror Zones shortly before.
seasons.notes: The October 6 date is in Blizzard's Patch 2.5 PTR notes; the exact time (October 6, 5 PM PDT; October 7, 2 AM CEST / 9 AM KST) comes from Maxroll only. End not published by Blizzard. aoeah.com lists 'February 15, 2022' (an obvious typo, likely 2023); arpgseasons.com uses the Season 3 start. Left null.

seasons.theme: Patch 2.6 added new runewords, including Mosaic, Metamorphosis and Hustle.
seasons.notes: Start time (February 16, 2023, 5 PM PST) comes from Wowhead; Maxroll gives the February 16 date. I did not find Blizzard's own Season 3 launch post. Fextralife dates Patch 2.6 as February 17, 2023, a day after the ladder start; not resolved. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says May 2, 2023 (the day Patch 2.7 went live at 10 AM PDT); arpgseasons.com uses the Season 4 start. Left null.

seasons.theme: Patch 2.7 added four extra character slots in all online modes and automated chat moderation.
seasons.notes: Start: May 4, 2023, 5:00 PM PDT. Patch 2.7 went live May 2, 2023, 10:00 AM PDT. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says September 14, 2023; arpgseasons.com uses the Season 5 start (September 28). Left null.

Start: September 28, 2023, 2:00 PM PDT (11:00 PM CEST, September 29 6:00 AM KST). This is earlier than the usual 5 PM slot, but Blizzard's post and Maxroll agree. No patch launched with the season; Patch 2.7.2 followed mid-season on November 14. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says February 22, 2024; arpgseasons.com uses the Season 6 start. Left null.

seasons.theme: A plain leaderboard reset with no new content.
seasons.notes: Start: February 22, 2024, 5:00 PM PST. The 'no new content' statement comes from Maxroll. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says May 21, 2024, the day Patch 2.7.3 went live at 10 AM PDT; arpgseasons.com uses the Season 7 start. Left null.

seasons.theme: Patch 2.7.3 lowered the age restriction in Korea to 19; no new gameplay content.
seasons.notes: Start: May 23, 2024, 5:00 PM PDT. Maxroll mislabels it PST. Patch 2.7.3 went live May 21, 2024, 10:00 AM PDT. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says August 20, 2024, the day Patch 2.7.4 went live; arpgseasons.com uses the Season 8 start. Left null.

seasons.theme: Patch 2.7.4 brought bug fixes and player-reporting updates.
seasons.notes: Start: August 23, 2024, 5 PM PDT. Patch 2.7.4 went live August 20. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says December 3, 2024, the day Patch 2.8.0 went live; arpgseasons.com uses the Season 9 start. Left null.

seasons.theme: Patch 2.8.0 made move directions bindable, allowing WASD movement.
seasons.notes: Start: December 6, 2024, 5 PM PST. Patch 2.8.0 went live December 3. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says March 7, 2025, the same day Season 10 started; arpgseasons.com agrees, using the Season 10 start. Left null because there is no official source.
Start: March 7, 2025, 5 PM PST. Blizzard's post names no patch or new features. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says June 20, 2025, the day Season 11 started. Left null.
Start: June 20, 2025, 5:00 PM PDT. Blizzard's post names no patch or new features. End not published by Blizzard: aoeah.com says October 3, 2025, the day Season 12 started. Left null.

Start: October 3, 2025, 5:00 PM PDT. End: February 11, 2026, 9 AM PST, from Blizzard's Season 13 post. The end matches the Reign of the Warlock launch (DiabloBytes dates its patch notes February 11, 2026). Conflicts: seasondex.com gives the start as October 10, 2025, and arpgseasons.com gives the end as February 21, 2026. Both contradict Blizzard.

seasons.theme: First ladder season after the Reign of the Warlock expansion, which added the Warlock class.
seasons.notes: Start: February 20, 2026, 5:00 PM PST (Blizzard). Patch 3.1.1 is dated February 20, 2026 by Fextralife, and seasondex lists v3.1.1; this is secondary. The expansion launch patch was 3.1 (February 11), and DiabloBytes calls it '3.0'. Conflicts: a DiabloBytes article says Season 13 launched March 6, 2026, and Blizzard Watch says February 20 at 9 AM Pacific. Both contradict Blizzard. End not published by Blizzard: Patch 3.2 went live May 19, 2026 (mp1st), and Season 14 started May 22. Secondary sites list May 22/23. Left null.

seasons.theme: Patch 3.2 brought large Warlock changes and Terror Zone changes.
seasons.notes: Start: May 22, 2026, 5:00 PM PDT. Maxroll mislabels it PST. End: Monday, August 17, 2026, 11 AM PDT, from Blizzard's Season 15 post. Patch 3.2 went live May 19, 2026 (mp1st). Conflict: arpgseasons.com says Season 14 ran to September 15, 2026, which is wrong.

seasons.theme: Patch 3.3 brought Terror Zone and Colossal Ancients changes plus a set of item adjustments.
seasons.notes: Start: August 21, 2026, 5:00 PM PDT (August 22, 1 AM BST / 2 AM CEST / 8 AM CST / 9 AM KST). Patch 3.3 rolled out Tuesday, August 18. End: Monday, November 9, 2026, 11 a.m. PST, from Blizzard's Season 16 post. Conflicts: seasondex.com and ggseason.com had estimated about November 28, 2026, aoeah.com about November 16; these predate the announcement. arpgseasons.com wrongly shows a different current season, 'Season of Hell's Legacy', starting September 15, 2026.

seasons.theme: Patch 3.4 moves some Reign of the Warlock items from Ladder-only to Non-Ladder and updates others on Online Ladder and Offline.
seasons.notes: Start: Friday, November 13, 2026, 5 p.m. PST, which is 01:00 UTC on November 14. Blizzard's regional list agrees for 3 a.m. CEST, 9 a.m. CST and 10 a.m. KST, but its '1:00 a.m. BST' would be 00:00 UTC; the UK is on GMT by then, so this looks like a mislabel, and the PST time is used. Patch 3.4 begins rolling out Monday, November 9 (no time given). The item changes apply to Reign of the Warlock only, not Classic or LoD. From November 16 (no time given), online Expansion (LoD) characters can no longer convert to Reign of the Warlock. Blizzard has announced no end date.
